title: Jeeta Mere Baba
body:
jeeta mere baba ko khuda laaye to laaye
dewdi pa khadi rehti hoo mai aas lagaye
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
hajj karke phire ahle watan khair se ghar ko
par qibla o kaaba gaye kaabe se kidhar ko
zehra ka pisar suye madina nahi aaya
is chand ki royat ka mahina nahi aaya
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
paida huwe asghar to payame ajal aaya
bhaiya ko na jee bhar ke galay se bhi lagaya
daakhil kahe din ab bhi na ghar may huwe nani
asghar ko cheh mahine safar may huwe nani
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
bhoole se bhi kunbe ne na ek roz kiya yaad
mai inko faramosh hoo wo mujhko sada yaad
shab kaun siyaahi ke mai sona nahi bhooli
par yaad may maa baap ke rona nahi bhooli
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
baba pe kate khair se ya rab ye mahina
hazrat se ladayi ka kahin ho na kareena
koofe ki taraf se jo hawa aati hai nani
sab kunbe ke rone ki sada aati hai nani
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
kya jaane musafir mere us waqt kahan hai
lillaah ghareebon ka nigehban to jahan hai
roshan rahe dunya may charaghare abaaje
dil mera bujha jaata hai jhokon se hawa ke
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
kyun aaj parinde nahi lete hai basera
un taayiro ke udne se hosh udta hai mera
bilkul ghazab o kehre ilaahi ki ghadi hai
kya jaaniye kis ghar pe tabahi ye padi hai
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
<<DIVIDER>>
khamosh dabeer ab ke qayamat ka hai aalam
shia koi be-hosh koi gham may hai is dam
jab tak chaman e bazm ki bunyaad rahegi
rangeen sukhani sab ko teri yaad rahegi
dewdi pa khadi…
jeeta mere baba…
